name: Logbook
summary: A traveller's logbook. The home page opens on one journey, day by day: the stop's photograph large on the left, the entry in the middle (days, place, a few lines, the stops), and the country drawn full height on the right with the route drawing itself to the stop chosen. Beneath it, four journeys as a quiet index. The year below draws each journey as a line across the months. Cool off-white ground, ink, one lichen-orange accent; Familjen Grotesk alone, set large and tight against small and plain. Square edges, hairline rules, no shadows. For independent tour operators.
